## History

John Henry Carter was hired as a boy from [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) by Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). While working for his employer, he originated and spread various stories.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)_

## Relationships

### [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harrison--john-henry-carter.md)

[Harrison](../character/harrison.md) serves as John Henry Carter's employer, having hired him by Volume 2. Following a severe hail and thunder storm that strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and damages the village, [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) suffers the loss of his parrot. During the aftermath of the storm, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to discuss the widespread destruction caused by the event, including the downfall of a blighted old house.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), +2 more_

- Serves under — employer who hired him  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P6](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0006)</sub>
